Questions

What is ChartSense AI?

ChartSense AI is analysis software for crypto, forex and metals charts. It scans crypto with live market data, or reads an uploaded chart image, and returns key levels, chart patterns, order-book context and risk metrics in about 2 minutes. It never places trades and is not financial advice.

Which markets does ChartSense support?

Live Analysis uses live exchange data and is built for crypto. Screenshot Analysis reads a chart image you upload and works for crypto, forex and metals charts.

What happens after the $1 trial?

Nothing. It's a one-time $1 payment for 5 credits with no automatic renewal. When they run out, you choose whether to pick a monthly plan.

Does ChartSense place trades?

No. It's analysis software and never executes trades. Each report is AI-generated analysis for you to review. It is not financial advice, can contain errors and guarantees nothing.

Live vs screenshot analysis?

Live analysis uses the live order book, recent trades and funding data. Screenshot analysis reads a chart image you upload and adds news and sentiment context, without live order-book data.

What can I upload to the Trading Psychologist?

A trade history as CSV, Excel, pasted text or a screenshot. It reads exports from most major exchanges and platforms, including Binance, Bybit, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, MetaTrader and TradingView. Each report uses 10 credits.

Can I get a refund?

Cancel a monthly plan anytime from your account. If you cancel within 7 days of your first plan payment and haven't used any credits, you get a full refund. The $1 trial is non-refundable.

How many credits does each tool use?

Live Analysis and Screenshot Analysis use 1 to 2 credits, 3D MetaScan uses 2, Catalyst Scanner uses 1 per coin, Market Conviction uses 1 and the Trading Psychologist uses 10.

How much does ChartSense AI cost?

A one-time $1 trial includes 5 credits with no automatic renewal. Monthly plans are Starter at $29 for 50 credits, Trader at $79 for 200 credits, Pro at $149 for 450 credits and Elite at $299 for 1,000 credits.

What is ChartSense AI?

ChartSense AI is analysis software for crypto, forex and metals charts. It scans crypto with live market data, or reads an uploaded chart image, and returns key levels, chart patterns, order-book context and risk metrics in about 2 minutes. It never places trades and is not financial advice.

Which markets does ChartSense support?

Live Analysis uses live exchange data and is built for crypto. Screenshot Analysis reads a chart image you upload and works for crypto, forex and metals charts.

What happens after the $1 trial?

没有什么。 It's a one-time $1 payment for 5 credits with no automatic renewal. When they run out, you choose whether to pick a monthly plan.

Does ChartSense place trades?

No. It's analysis software and never executes trades. Each report is AI-generated analysis for you to review. It is not financial advice, can contain errors and guarantees nothing.

Live vs screenshot analysis?

Live analysis uses the live order book, recent trades and funding data. Screenshot analysis reads a chart image you upload and adds news and sentiment context, without live order-book data.

What can I upload to the Trading Psychologist?

A trade history as CSV, Excel, pasted text or a screenshot. It reads exports from most major exchanges and platforms, including Binance, Bybit, Coinbase, Kraken, OKX, MetaTrader and TradingView. Each report uses 10 credits.

Can I get a refund?

Cancel a monthly plan anytime from your account. If you cancel within 7 days of your first plan payment and haven't used any credits, you get a full refund. The $1 trial is non-refundable.

How many credits does each tool use?

Live Analysis and Screenshot Analysis use 1 to 2 credits, 3D MetaScan uses 2, Catalyst Scanner uses 1 per coin, Market Conviction uses 1 and the Trading Psychologist uses 10.

How much does ChartSense AI cost?

A one-time $1 trial includes 5 credits with no automatic renewal. Monthly plans are Starter at $29 for 50 credits, Trader at $79 for 200 credits, Pro at $149 for 450 credits and Elite at $299 for 1,000 credits.
